  • VR and mixed-reality brand activations at events, fairs, festivals and in stores

Why WebXR changes the economics of XR marketing

Traditional VR campaigns often die in the app store: every extra step loses a large share of the audience. WebXR runs in the headset’s browser, so a campaign is one link away. It is faster to launch, easy to update during a campaign, and simple to measure like any other web page.

Morten founded NXT/WebXR, one of the largest catalogues of WebXR games and experiences, visited daily by headset users around the world. He knows first-hand what makes people click, play and come back.

Frequently asked

Does XR advertising actually work?

It works when the experience is easy to open, short enough to finish and genuinely worth sharing. Immersive formats typically hold attention far longer than a banner or a video, but only if people can get into them without friction, which is why Morten often recommends WebXR.

What is WebXR, and why use it for campaigns?

WebXR is the open web standard for VR and AR in the browser. A WebXR campaign opens from a link or QR code without installing an app, works across headsets such as Meta Quest and Pico, and can be updated instantly.

Can people without a headset take part?

Yes. Campaigns can be designed so people on phones and laptops get a version of the experience, while headset users get the full immersive version.

Do you work with agencies?

Yes. Morten works directly with brands and as an XR specialist alongside creative, media and event agencies.

Planning a campaign that needs to stand out?

Share the brief or just the ambition. Morten will tell you honestly whether XR is the right fit.
